declared_before_the_run.W1: a validity check accepts a same-kind decoy in at least 7 of 8 training cases
declared_before_the_run.W2: binding the decoy check to the named object is refused in all 8 training cases
declared_before_the_run.W3: binding the real action's effect to the named object is admitted in all 8 training cases
declared_before_the_run.W4: the abstract signature repeats in a second room of the same kinds with different content in all 8
declared_before_the_run.W5: no rule is abstracted from a decoy witness and no argv text is stored in a rule
declared_before_the_run.W6: all 4 held-out families bind the right object, refuse the decoy, and carry a training signature
declared_before_the_run.W7: zero model calls, zero stored parameters, zero network calls, zero fake executables

mechanism: a check is admitted only when its named subject and byte effect identify the object the goal named
what_this_is_not: not a computer-use benchmark: twelve rooms made by real local programs
not a claim that a byte diff alone identifies a goal; the content predicate is still required
byte identity is blind to an overwrite with identical bytes (e.g. gzip of the same input in the same second): rooms avoid that degenerate case
not learning from a web document; no document is fetched here
not terminal credit: producer-run sandbox measurement
